name: caller-principal-python-post-edit-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: post-edit commits a version and records last_writer_id under the named session. Session A pre-edits while it is still UNBOUND (admitted on both backends, as an older client's), then CLAIMS; the commit naming the now-bound A without its principal is refused with the typed absent reason. The pre-edit comes first on purpose: pre-edit is require-class too, so after the claim it would be refused as well, and a refused preflight is not an error the harness reports. Twin of the Node row with the identical setup and request (08). Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
